name: Bardo National Museum
subtitle: National museum established in 1888 in a former beylical palace, renowned for holding the world's finest Roman mosaic collections.

facts.label: Famous mosaic
facts.value: Virgil composing the Aeneid (3rd century AD)

parts.text: The national museum of Tunisia, housed in an ornate 15th- to 19th-century palace of the Husainid beys in Le Bardo. Established in 1888, it holds one of the world's most extensive collections of Roman mosaics, including the 3rd-century portrait of the poet Virgil writing the Aeneid, rescued from archaeological excavations across Carthage, Dougga, and El Jem.

gaps: Full digital inventory of Islamic and Punic holdings remains partially available online.
